page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1842.18 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1556.0, both falling into the average category. However, multi-core and memory subsystem benchmarks are constrained. The stress-ng multi-core score of 1932.39 and Geekbench multi-core score of 1815.0 are positioned in the bottom 10% of tested instances. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large-block read and write speeds measured at 15.1 GB/sec and 13.63 GB/sec respectively.

Given these performance metrics, the ecs.g7se.large is suited for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic web serving, and development environments rather than memory-intensive databases or parallel processing tasks. Its database performance is relatively low, as evidenced by a Passmark database score of 1038.28 and a Redis SET throughput of 1.97 million operations per second. The hardware profile offers a cost-efficient entry point for dedicated x86_64 CPU resources without the overhead of local storage or high-capacity networking.
